options.text: Both downhill. Reactions in living things always run by themselves.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "It is alive, so it goes."

options.text: Splitting starch is downhill and runs by itself once its hump is lowered. Joining amino acids is uphill and must be paid for with ATP.
Both uphill, because both need the seedling to be alive.

image.alt: Two amino acid beads joining with water falling out, beside a starch chain splitting apart as water is added.
